correctness.rationale: Each de Bruijn cycle uniquely determines local bijections at 16 vertices; all 65536 possibilities are checked and exactly 2048 give a single 32-edge orbit, fixing rotation at 00000. A separate direct Euler-tour depth-first search generates the same 2048 cyclic words. Both reproduce the 47-entry histogram, extrema, exact moments and complement/reversal orbits. The all-shift bipolar normalization is explicit. Third-party peak thresholds and rounded RMS averages independently agree.

exact_database_or_table.reasoning: A full table of 2048 peak/RMS averages had been published; its published aggregates cannot imply 47 exact distinct energies or the upper extremal orbit. Searches for a matching exact spectrum or tabulation gave no explicit duplicate. This is evidence of an additional invariant, not a proof of world-wide uniqueness.

originality.rationale: The closest inspected prior paper already analyzes all 2048 order-five cycles and averages their RMS sidelobes, which is expressly credited. The new contribution is an exact per-cycle 47-value total-squared periodic-correlation distribution (plus maximum-energy class, exact moments and complement/reversal orbit structure), which is not mathematically implied by the previously published three aggregate RMS averages, two peak thresholds, worst individual correlations or overlay plot. Relevant exact-formulation searches found no dominating theorem. Unindexed equivalents remain a risk.
residual_risks: 2011 authors necessarily computed correlation statistics for all 2048 cycles; unpublished underlying per-sequence data could have the equivalent histogram, but the inspected published tables and figures do not state it.
An unindexed specialist tabulation might record the exact 47-value spectrum under RMS, sidelobe energy, Fourier-fourth-moment, or spectral-flatness normalization.
A 2020 related filtered-generator paper was inspected only at the abstract level; this does not establish noncoverage of its full text, although its object is different.
No external independent mathematical audit has been performed.

value.rationale: Cyclic accumulated sidelobe energy is a mathematically natural fourth-spectral-moment / RMS measure for de Bruijn pseudorandom sequences. The complete order-five family of 2048 is a canonical first nontrivial finite universe for exact classification, not an arbitrarily chosen slice. Distinct cycles with identical maximum sidelobes have different cumulative energies. The 47 exact frequencies, absent attainable-grid values, sharp energy maximum and its symmetry orbit, and variance give information absent from the previous peak-count and RMS-mean studies. No unsupported physical-channel or general-order claims are made.
